scenes.title: Around the campfire Leo and Mara plan the quest
scenes.text:
Around the campfire Leo and Mara plan the quest for the moon crystal.
Mara (serious): "The old map says the crystal sleeps beneath the observatory dome."
Leo (warm): "Then at moonrise we wake it."
Mara (concern): "If the Rival gets there first, the valley will never see the sun again."
Leo (serious): "He will not get there first."

dialogue.speaker: Mara

dialogue.text: Then at moonrise we wake it.

scenes.title: At night in the old observatory Leo turns the mi
scenes.text: At night in the old observatory Leo turns the mirror wheels until a moonbeam strikes the crystal and the dome opens.

scenes.title: A thief snatches the star map and Leo chases him
scenes.text: A thief snatches the star map and Leo chases him through the crowded night market, vaulting the crates he topples.

scenes.title: Around the campfire Mara bandages Leo's hand whi
scenes.text:
Around the campfire Mara bandages Leo's hand while Tarn the scout brings news.
Tarn (concern): "The thief took the road through the swamp. The Rival's men are with him."
Leo (angry): "Then we follow him through the swamp and we do not stop."
Mara (warm): "You will not be going alone."

dialogue.speaker: Tarn
dialogue.text: The thief took the road through the swamp. The Rival's men are with him.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Then we follow him through the swamp and we do not stop.

dialogue.speaker: Mara
dialogue.text: You will not be going alone.

scenes.title: Leo poles a punt through the mangrove swamp whil
scenes.text: Leo poles a punt through the mangrove swamp while crocodiles lunge from the dark water.

scenes.title: Deep in the jungle Leo swings from vine to vine
scenes.text: Deep in the jungle Leo swings from vine to vine across a ravine toward the ancient temple.

scenes.title: Inside the desert temple a giant boulder is rele
scenes.text: Inside the desert temple a giant boulder is released and Leo outruns it, jumps the pit and slides under the closing door.

scenes.title: Around the campfire the travellers rest after th
scenes.text:
Around the campfire the travellers rest after the temple and the cold wind turns to snow.
Mara (sad): "I thought we had lost you in the temple."
Leo (warm): "You will not lose me that easily."
Tarn (joy): "Look, the pass to the ice cave is open. We can reach the north by morning!"

dialogue.speaker: Mara
dialogue.text: I thought we had lost you in the temple.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: You will not lose me that easily.

dialogue.speaker: Tarn
dialogue.text: Look, the pass to the ice cave is open. We can reach the north by morning!

scenes.title: In the ice cave Leo leaps between drifting ice f
scenes.text: In the ice cave Leo leaps between drifting ice floes while stalactites crash around him.

scenes.title: At the volcano forge Leo hammers a glowing sword
scenes.text: At the volcano forge Leo hammers a glowing sword on the anvil beside the lava river and quenches it.

scenes.title: Leo dives into the coral reef, opens a giant cla
scenes.text: Leo dives into the coral reef, opens a giant clam for the pearl and escapes a shark.

scenes.title: Leo sprints across the rotten rope bridge as the
scenes.text: Leo sprints across the rotten rope bridge as the planks fall away behind him.

scenes.title: Leo crosses the floating city, riding the moving
scenes.text: Leo crosses the floating city, riding the moving platforms above the clouds.

scenes.title: In the council hall the elder gives Leo the last
scenes.text:
In the council hall the elder gives Leo the last key before the final climb.
Elder (serious): "The Rival has woken the stone giant, and only the core in its chest can stop it."
Leo (serious): "Then I will take the core from its chest."
Elder (concern): "Be careful. Nobody has climbed it and come down."

dialogue.speaker: Elder
dialogue.text: The Rival has woken the stone giant, and only the core in its chest can stop it.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Then I will take the core from its chest.

dialogue.speaker: Elder
dialogue.text: Be careful. Nobody has climbed it and come down.

scenes.title: A stone giant lifts its arm and Leo rides the pa
scenes.text: A stone giant lifts its arm and Leo rides the palm, walks to the shoulder and pulls the glowing core from its chest.

scenes.title: At sunset Leo rides a dragon through the canyon
scenes.text: At sunset Leo rides a dragon through the canyon between the rock spires and under the stone arch.

scenes.title: On the moonlit tower the rival mage and Leo trad
scenes.text: On the moonlit tower the rival mage and Leo trade spells in a magic duel, and Leo's shield turns the last spell back.

scenes.title: Around the campfire the travellers laugh togethe
scenes.text:
Around the campfire the travellers laugh together at last.
Mara (joy): "You did it! The valley will see the sun again!"
Leo (warm): "We did it. All of us."
Tarn (joy): "Then let us go home!"

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: We did it. All of us.

dialogue.speaker: Tarn
dialogue.text: Then let us go home!
